definition: What an average household owns (land, buildings, livestock, vehicles, financial assets) minus what it owes. Accumulated wealth runs a far wider gap than monthly spending, though the gap narrowed between 2012 and 2018: urban Muslim households went from holding about half the net worth of urban Hindu households to about two-thirds.
figures: Muslim INR 15.0 lakh vs Hindu INR 18.8 lakh in 2018, INR 3.8 lakh behind.
name: Household net worth
